newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT--U S West Media sells Time-Warner shares.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT--U S West Media sells Time-Warner shares.

text.p: U S West Media Group, one of the largest broadband communications companies in the U.S., said on Thursday that it sold over 4.4 million Time Warner Inc shares to Salomon Inc's investment banking arm, Salomon Brothers for about $220 million. U S West Media said the sale was part of a plan to liquidate non-strategic assets.
A full text of the company's statement follows.
DENVER, July 12 /PRNewswire/ -- U S WEST Media Group today said it sold slightly more than 4.4 million shares in Time Warner as part of a plan to liquidate nonstrategic assets.

The Time Warner shares were sold to Salomon Brothers for about $220 million, a price Media Group termed "attractive." The company added that the sale of the shares is in no way related to Media Group's 25 percent interest in Time Warner Entertainment, which does not change as a result of this sale.
As of today, the company said it has sold or agreed to sell nearly $700 million worth of nonstrategic assets this year, well on its way toward a goal of $1 billion for 1997.

This total does not include the sale of cable systems within the 14-state territory served by U S WEST Communications that Media Group must sell to comply with federal law. (Such sales, amounting to more than $600 million, were announced last month.)

Media Group acquired the Time Warner shares in its merger with Continental Cablevision (now MediaOne) late last year. Continental had acquired the shares as a result of a cable-industry initiative to infuse capital into Turner Broadcasting Co. in 1987. The Turner shares owned by
Continental as a result of that capital infusion were converted into Time Warner shares when Turner and Time Warner merged last year.

The U S WEST Media Group (NYSE: UMG), one of America's largest broadband communications companies, is involved in domestic and international cable and telephony, wireless communications, and directory and information services. For 1996, Media Group reported proportionate revenues of $6.4 billion. Media Group is one of two major groups that make up U S WEST, a company in the connections business, helping customers share information, entertainment and communications services in local markets worldwide. U S WEST's other major group, U S WEST Communications, provides telecommunications services in 14 western and midwestern states. SOURCE U S WEST Media Group
